title: Post-renovation cleaning
summary: Fine dust, residue and protective films removed with care, so you can move back in straight away.

meta.title: Post-renovation cleaning in Luxembourg
meta.description: Careful cleaning after renovation or building works in Luxembourg homes: fine dust, paint and plaster residue, protective films and new surfaces.

hero.intro: After the builders leave, fine dust settles everywhere. We remove it methodically, treat new materials with the care they need and leave your home ready to live in.

image.alt: A newly renovated kitchen with protective film being removed from a cabinet

included.intro: We start with an assessment of the materials and finishes, so that every surface gets the right method and product.

faq.question: When should the clean take place?
faq.answer: Once all trades have finished in the rooms concerned. If decorators or fitters are still due, a two-stage clean avoids paying twice for the same rooms.

faq.question: Do you remove building waste?
faq.answer: We remove packaging and light debris from the clean. Bulky waste and rubble are the contractor's responsibility, or we can recommend a licensed partner.

faq.question: Can you clean delicate new materials?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us about natural stone, oiled wood, lacquer or specialist coatings and we will follow the manufacturer's care guidance.

faq.question: Is this for homes only?
faq.answer: This page covers private homes. For offices, shops and commercial premises, see our commercial post-construction service.
